name: foundryvtt-mythic-gme
description: A set of Macros and Random Tables for playing with the Mythic Game Master Emulator

scripts.copy: cp ./README.md dist/ && cp ./CHANGELOG.md dist/ && cp ./LICENSE.md dist/ && cp ./module.json dist/ && cp ./THANKS.txt dist/ && cp -r ./packs dist/ && cp -r ./icons dist/ && cp -r ./lang dist/ && cp -r template dist/
scripts.copyWin: copy README.md dist && copy CHANGELOG.md dist && copy LICENSE.md dist && copy module.json dist && copy THANKS.txt dist && xcopy /Y /E /I packs dist\packs && xcopy /Y /E /I icons dist\icons && xcopy /Y /E /I lang dist\lang && xcopy /Y /E /I template dist\template
scripts.dev: npm run buildWin && npm run deploy

author: JeansenVaars (Saif Ellafi)
